blocks.text: Fig. 19.1 ka graph yeh bhi dikhata hai ke A = 50 tak binding energy per nucleon barhti hai. Is liye jab do halke nuclei mil kar aisa bhari nucleus banayen jis ka mass number A 50 se kam ho, to energy nikalti hai. Mass defect aur binding energy wale topic mein hum ne dekha ke do protons aur do neutrons mil kar helium nucleus banayen to taqreeban 27 MeV energy nikalti hai.

blocks.title: Fusion reaction
blocks.text: Woh nuclear reaction jis mein do halke nuclei mil kar ek bhari nucleus banayen, fusion reaction kehlata hai.

Fusion mein kuch mass kam hota hai aur us ke barabar energy nikalti hai. Fusion mein fission ke muqable per nucleon zyada energy mil sakti hai. Lekin fusion karna zyada mushkil hai: do positive charge wale nuclei ko bohat qareeb lana parta hai, aur is ke liye un ke darmiyan electrostatic repulsion (dhakelne wali force) ke khilaf kaam karna parta hai. Is liye fusion shuru karne ke liye bohat zyada energy chahiye. Yani fusion se energy zyada milti hai, lekin use shuru karne par bhi bohat energy kharch hoti hai.
Do halke nuclei ke fusion ki probability (imkan, chance) wahan zyada hai jahan ek proton ya ek neutron banta hai:

blocks.text_alt: or ²₁H + ²₁H → ³₂He + ¹₀n + 3.3 MeV   (19.7)

blocks.text: In dono reactions mein taqreeban 1.0 MeV per nucleon energy nikalti hai (maslan 4.0 MeV ÷ 4 nucleons), jo fission ki per nucleon energy (taqreeban 0.9 MeV) ke qareeb hai. Agar ²₁H (deuterium) aur ³₁H (tritium) ko zabardasti fuse karayen to 17.6 MeV energy milti hai:

blocks.text_alt: i.e., ²₁H + ³₁H → ⁴₂He + ¹₀n + 17.6 MeV   (19.8)

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: D-T fusion mein 5 nucleons se 17.6 MeV, yani taqreeban 3.5 MeV per nucleon milti hai; yeh fission (taqreeban 0.9 MeV per nucleon) se kai guna zyada hai.

In reactions mein ²₁H aur ³₁H ko fusion fuels kehte hain. Do halke nuclei ke fusion ke liye un ke darmiyan dhakelne wali force ke khilaf kaam karna parta hai, is liye dono nuclei ko bohat tez speed se ek doosre ki taraf takraya jata hai. Ek tareeqa yeh hai ke accelerator ki madad se in nuclei ko bohat zyada velocity di jaye (Fig. 19.6).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab fusion fuels '¹₁H + ³₁H' likhti hai. In reactions ke fuels deuterium aur tritium, yani ²₁H aur ³₁H, hain (Eq. 19.8); ¹₁H to Eq. 19.6 ka product hai.

blocks.alt: Do deuterium nuclei (har aik aik proton aur aik neutron) takra kar tritium nucleus (do neutrons aur aik proton) aur urta hua proton banate hain (4.0 MeV). Phir yahi tritium aur aik aur deuterium takra kar helium nucleus (do protons, do neutrons) aur urta hua neutron banate hain (17.6 MeV). Key: neutron, proton, deuterium, tritium, helium.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.6: fusion reaction (kitab ki Figure 19.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle qadam mein do deuterium mil kar tritium aur aik proton banate hain (4.0 MeV, reaction 19.6). 'Then' ke baad yahi tritium aik aur deuterium se mil kar helium aur aik neutron banata hai (17.6 MeV, reaction 19.8). Lehriya lines urne wale particle ki motion (harkat) dikhati hain.

Yeh tareeqa ²₁H aur ³₁H ke fusion ki research (tehqeeq) mein istemal hua hai, lekin bare scale (paimane) par lagataar energy lene ke liye kaam nahi aata. Doosra tareeqa is principle (usool) par hai ke kisi cheez ka temperature barhne se us ke atoms ki speed barhti hai. Fusion shuru karne ke liye halke nuclei ko zaroori speed taqreeban 10 million (1 crore) degree Celsius par milti hai. Itne zyada temperature par hone wale reaction ko thermonuclear reaction kehte hain. Aam taur par itna temperature hasil nahi ho sakta, lekin atom bomb ke dhamake mein bohat thodi der ke liye mil jata hai.

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye
blocks.text: 'Artificial Sun' (insan ka banaya hua Sooraj) se murad China ke EAST aur HL-2M/HL-3 jaise experimental (tajurbe wale) fusion reactors hain. Yeh hydrogen isotopes ko 100 million °C se zyada, Sooraj ke core (markaz) se bhi zyada, garam karte hain taake Sooraj jaisa fusion kar ke saaf aur unlimited (be-hisaab) energy hasil ki ja sake.

Ab tak fusion reaction sirf hydrogen bomb ke tests (tajurbon) mein dekha gaya hai, jise atom bomb se trigger (shuru) kiya jata hai. Fusion se bohat zyada energy mil sakti hai, lekin abhi tak ise fission ki tarah control nahi kiya ja saka, is liye is se bijli nahi banti. Is field (maidan) mein bohat koshishen ho rahi hain aur umeed hai ke jald is ko control karne ka tareeqa mil jayega. Fusion sitaron, aur hamare Sooraj, ke core (markaz) mein lagataar ho raha hai.
